# fixed field　`def.fixed-field`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.fixed-field)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.fixed-field.md)

⚠ A fixed field is in general **not equal** to some elementary construction of "the field fixing every element": it looks at all elements of $H$ together, not at fixed points element by element.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
